test_access: prohibited; runner and verifier open only train.jsonl and validation.jsonl
lambda_rationale: At equal logits the per-endpoint ranking term is log(1 + reliable_negative_count). lambda=0.05 is fixed as a modest initial auxiliary scale (roughly a few tenths of the 0.693 balanced-BCE-at-zero scale for the observed candidate counts); it is not searched or selected on validation performance.
label_semantics: Only upper-triangular pairs selected by the existing canonical AU/GC/GU, minimum separation, padding and observed-mask candidate set are supervised. Unknown pairs are masked. Competition negatives are only explicitly supervised compatible pairs with label 0; positive-only endpoints without known negatives are skipped.
initialization: Fresh random initialization for all runs; exact per-seed state hashes above; paired conditions start from identical state.
sampling: Uniformly sample split_group_id, then uniformly sample an RNA within that group, with replacement; paired conditions share the exact precomputed 550-update schedule for each seed.
checkpoint: Final optimizer update only; no validation checkpoint selection or early stopping.
primary_metric: validation group-macro F1 (RNA F1 averaged within split_group_id, then equally across groups)
secondary_metrics: predecode legal-candidate multi-partner endpoint rate at threshold 0.5, using all sequence-compatible candidates irrespective of observed-label masks, averaged per RNA then per group

multi_partner_conflict_diagnostic.candidate_rule: All AU/GC/GU-compatible pairs at sequence separation >=4, independent of observed-label masks and pair truth.
multi_partner_conflict_diagnostic.conflict_rule: An endpoint is conflicting when at least two legal partners have sigmoid score >= threshold_probability.
multi_partner_conflict_diagnostic.aggregation: Conflict endpoints divided by all nucleotides per RNA, then arithmetic mean within group, then equal mean across validation groups.

gate.delta_rationale: Predeclared minimum practical gain of two absolute F1 points for continuation; set as an engineering utility threshold before any formal run, not estimated from the outcomes.
gate.group_rule: Compare per-group F1 averaged across the three paired seeds; at least 4 of 7 groups must improve and no group may decline by more than 0.10 absolute F1.
gate.pass_rule: All three seed-level group-macro deltas are positive, their mean is at least delta_loss, at least 4/7 group-averaged deltas are positive, and no severe group regression occurs.
gate.failure_rule: Technical failure is retained and reported; no metric-driven retries, extra seeds, lambda search, threshold changes, or protocol edits. Missing any one of six runs stops the conclusion.

adoption_rules.candidate: partner competition function as implemented and tested
adoption_rules.development_gate_pass: eligible for optional integration after independent checkpoint verification; no automatic default change
adoption_rules.development_gate_fail: stop or retain as unadopted candidate; do not retune
adoption_rules.optional_integration: only after gate pass and reload verification; this experiment itself does not change training CLI

limitations: Only 88 training RNAs and 10 validation RNAs in 8/7 groups.
The validation set is development evidence and has been seen previously.
No new independent test exists; results cannot establish broad cross-family generalization.
The stage-2 auxiliary source pilot failed admission; this is an isolated loss comparison on approved experimental labels, not an auxiliary-data A/B/C result.
